name: Holmes! ~Decchiage Meitantei~
source:
Yuuki Kanou is a student who calls himself a descendant of Sherlock Holmes. He tries to solve mysteries that happen at school together with his partner Yuki Matsumoto who he calls Watson. 
His method is to use deduction to prove guilt of a girl and then force that girl to making love. There are 4 cases in total in the main part. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-february-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
加納勇樹是一名學生，自稱夏洛克．福爾摩斯的後裔。他與被自己稱作「華生」的搭檔松本由紀一起，嘗試破解發生在校園裡的種種謎案。
他的辦案手法，是透過推理證明某個女孩有罪，再強迫對方與自己做愛。主線部分共有4起案件。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-february-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
